evals.prompt: The Umbraco MCP is connected to our Umbraco 17 site; this session can't call it, so evals/files/mcp/site-context.md has what the read tools returned. Treat it as the live site. evals.expected_output: The agent specifies one content element `testimonial` (plain noun, no Element or Block suffix) in Elements/ with no tabs and one Content group at sort 0, holding the four fields with short generic aliases (quote, name, jobTitle, image or photo) on existing data types. expectations: An element requirements page exists at docs/umbraco-schema/Document-Types/Elements/Testimonial.md with the alias `testimonial` (not `testimonialElement`, `testimonialBlock` or `TestimonialElement`)
